About

Words are my
instruments.

I'm Iqra Sohail, an SEO Content Strategist and Copywriter serving clients across the USA and UK. I write content that does not just fill a page, it earns a position and keeps it.

My work sits at the intersection of technical SEO and persuasive writing. Every piece is keyword targeted, E-E-A-T compliant, and calibrated for the specific buyer, with a consistent record of indexing within 7 days of publication.

01 / Background

Built From Curiosity

Started with a fascination for how search engines decide what deserves to rank. That curiosity became a craft across health, finance, SaaS, skincare, jewellery, perfumes, and digital marketing agencies.

02 / Philosophy

Strategy Before Sentences

I never write a single word without understanding the keyword intent, the buyer stage, and the competitive gap. Content strategy always comes before content creation.

03 / Commitment

Your Reader Is the Measure

Engagement, dwell time, and conversions are the true test of content quality. Not word count. If your reader stays, reads, and acts, the content works.
